meta.name: distilly
meta.description: Build and use evidence-grounded local person profiles with Distilly's exact five-tool workflow. Use when a user asks to research, ingest, distill, update, correct, retrieve, or recall a real or fictional person's profile, voice, boundaries, or evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立并调用有依据的人物档案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用到有条理、可复核的人物资料
copy.tagline_en: Build and retrieve evidence-based persona profiles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with structured, verifiable person profiles.

howto.what: 装上后，当你请AI处理某个真实或虚构人物的资料时，它会先确认这个人是谁，再把你给的文字拆成一条条带原文依据的要点，最后建成一份本地档案；之后你可随时查档或要求更正。
howto.when: 当你提出要研究、整理或回忆某个真实或虚构人物，或要对已有档案做改动时触发。

say.text: 根据这段采访稿，为李华建一份人物档案。
say.note: AI会先确认该人物是否已有档案；若无，则用这段材料新建档案。

say.text: 把张三已保存的档案内容调出来。
say.note: AI会检索对应档案并按请求返回内容。

say.text: 更正：李明的生日是3月5日，不是4月。
say.note: AI会保存这句更正，并在证据允许时更新档案。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask the AI to handle a real or fictional person, it resolves the person, turns your supplied text into evidence-backed claims, and saves them in a local profile. Later you can retrieve or correct that profile.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to research, organize, or recall a real/fictional person, or to change an existing profile.

say_en.text: Build a profile for Li Hua from this interview transcript.
say_en.note: Checks for an existing profile; otherwise creates one.

say_en.text: Show the saved profile for Zhang San.
say_en.note: It fetches the stored profile and returns its content.

say_en.text: Correction: Li Ming's birthday is March 5, not April.
say_en.note: It saves the correction and applies it when evidence exists.
